paragraphs.text: 1. LARGE was that covering, and firm of texture, folded wherein thou enteredst the waters.
One Deity alone, O Jatavedas Agni, saw all thy forms in sundry places.
paragraphs.original: विश्वा अपश्यद्बहुधा ते अग्ने जातवेदस्तन्वो देव एकः
paragraphs.translit: viśvā apaśyadbahudhā te agne jātavedastanvo deva ekaḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. What God hath seen me? Who of all their number clearly beheld my forms in many places?
paragraphs.original: को मा ददर्श कतमः स देवो यो मे तन्वो बहुधा पर्यपश्यत् ।
paragraphs.translit: ko mā dadarśa katamaḥ sa devo yo me tanvo bahudhā paryapaśyat |

paragraphs.text: Where lie, then, all the sacred logs of Agni that lead him God-ward, Varuna and Mitra?
3. In many places, Agni Jatavedas, we sought thee hidden in the plants and waters.
paragraphs.original: ऐच्छाम त्वा बहुधा जातवेदः प्रविष्टमग्ने अप्स्वोषधीषु ।
paragraphs.translit: aicchāma tvā bahudhā jātavedaḥ praviṣṭamagne apsvoṣadhīṣu |

paragraphs.text: Then Yama marked thee, God of wondrous splendour! effulgent from thy tenfold secret dwelling,
4. I fled in fear from sacrificial worship, Varuna, lest the Gods should thus engage me.
paragraphs.original: होत्रादहं वरुण बिभ्यदायं नेदेव मा युनजन्नत्र देवाः ।
paragraphs.translit: hotrādahaṃ varuṇa bibhyadāyaṃ nedeva mā yunajannatra devāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Thus were my forms laid down in many places. This, as my goal, I Agni saw before me.
paragraphs.original: तस्य मे तन्वो बहुधा निविष्टा एतमर्थं न चिकेताहमग्निः
paragraphs.translit: tasya me tanvo bahudhā niviṣṭā etamarthaṃ na ciketāhamagniḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. Come; man is pious and would fain do worship, he waits prepared: in gloom thou, Agni, dwellest.
Make pathways leading God-ward clear and easy, and bear oblations with a kindly spirit.
6. This goal mine elder brothers erst selected, as he who drives a car the way to travel.
So,Varuna, I fled afar through terror, as flies the wild-bull from an archer's bowstring.
paragraphs.original: तस्माद्भिया वरुण दूरमायं गौरो न क्षेप्नोरविजे ज्यायाः
paragraphs.translit: tasmādbhiyā varuṇa dūramāyaṃ gauro na kṣepnoravije jyāyāḥ

paragraphs.text: 7. We give thee life unwasting, Jatavedas, so that, employed, thou never shalt be injured.
paragraphs.original: कुर्मस्त आयुरजरं यदग्ने यथा युक्तो जातवेदो न रिष्याः ।
paragraphs.translit: kurmasta āyurajaraṃ yadagne yathā yukto jātavedo na riṣyāḥ |

paragraphs.text: So, nobly born! shalt thou with kindly spirit bear to the Gods their share of men's oblations.
paragraphs.original: अथा वहासि सुमनस्यमानो भागं देवेभ्यो हविषः सुजात
paragraphs.translit: athā vahāsi sumanasyamāno bhāgaṃ devebhyo haviṣaḥ sujāta

paragraphs.text: 8. Grant me the first oblations and the latter, entire, my forceful shares of holy presents,
paragraphs.original: प्रयाजान्मे अनुयाजाँश्च केवलानूर्जस्वन्तं हविषो दत्त भागम् ।
paragraphs.translit: prayājānme anuyājām̐śca kevalānūrjasvantaṃ haviṣo datta bhāgam |

paragraphs.text: The soul of plants, the fatness of the waters, and let there be long life, ye Gods, to Agni.
paragraphs.original: घृतं चापां पुरुषं चौषधीनामग्नेश्च दीर्घमायुरस्तु देवाः
paragraphs.translit: ghṛtaṃ cāpāṃ puruṣaṃ cauṣadhīnāmagneśca dīrghamāyurastu devāḥ

paragraphs.text: 9. Thine be the first oblations and the latter, entire, thy forceful shares of holy presents.
paragraphs.original: तव प्रयाजा अनुयाजाश्च केवल ऊर्जस्वन्तो हविषः सन्तु भागाः ।
paragraphs.translit: tava prayājā anuyājāśca kevala ūrjasvanto haviṣaḥ santu bhāgāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Let all this sacrifice be thine, O Agni, and let the world's four regions bow before thee.
